answer: A 5% audit lottery fines fakes on a doubling scale. Fines double per fake from one operator, $200, $400, $800. Each epoch a zephyr draw picks 5% of identities, and 9 peer auditors check each pick before close for hardware key, liveness, and work history. A verdict counts only when signed with the auditor's quill. One caught fake exposes its funding thread, and every identity on it faces audit next epoch. 100 clones cost $3,000 to set up plus $6,200 expected first-epoch fines, $9,200 total, versus $30 for one honest agent. The net bills double for every extra fish from the same school.
